  ABCD-EVAL-SENTINEL-WARM-KEY, written as a block scalar so the excluded key's

  ABCD-EVAL-SENTINEL-BLOCK-SCALAR after a blank line INSIDE the block, which is
  still part of the value; a drop that stopped at the first blank line, or that
  took the key line alone, would leave one or both of these behind.
